note: Declared HS 870899 matches the observed export HS 87089900 (motor vehicle parts/bushings) — no HS correction needed. Export side is factually confirmed with dated customs/B-L records to USA, Canada and South Africa, so this is a real shipper, not a catalogue claim. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: web_search returned connection errors (searx unavailable) and thecompanycheck/zaubacorp returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are null — not public to me in this session, not evidence of absence. Revenue: null (not public). Note the ImportKey page also lists Bindra Motors among suppliers of unrelated buyers (e.g. Suprajit Engineering, Ask Automotive) — that is the aggregator's co-occurrence listing, not proof of a domestic supply relationship, so it is not counted as domestic evidence. Role: manufacturer_trader (exports own-branded part numbers to Automann group, imports wire ropes from China). No rejection grounds: entity exists and is actively trading.
